name: HADDOCK3
summary: Integrative biomolecular docking and refinement, including protein complexes and protein–DNA/RNA systems.

steps: Read the official Python installation guide and check the current Python and operating-system requirements.
Create a fresh virtual environment and install a deliberately selected haddock3 release from PyPI; record the version and dependency resolution.
For protein–DNA/RNA docking, read the separate nucleic-acid best-practice guide before preparing structures or restraints.
install.verify_note: Run haddock3 --help in the isolated environment; use the official test configuration separately for a functional run.

notes: A PyPI installation route is documented, but this recipe is guidance-only until a version and each declared platform are validated here.
